lines: Chaandi jaisa rang hai tera, sone jaise baal
Ek tu hi dhanwaan hai gori, baaqi sab kangaal
couplets.en: Your skin is silver and your hair is gold, and beside you everyone else is poor.

lines: Jis raste se tu guzre, woh phoolon se bhar jaaye
Jis raste se tu guzre, woh phoolon se bhar jaaye
couplets.en: Every path you walk fills with flowers.

lines: Tere pair ki komal aahat, sote bhaag jagaaye
Jo patthar chhoo le gori tu, woh heera ban jaaye
couplets.en: Your soft footfall wakes sleeping fortune, and any stone you touch becomes a diamond.

lines: Tu jis ko mil jaaye woh
Tu jis ko mil jaaye woh ho jaaye maala-maal
couplets.en: Whoever finds you comes into riches.

lines: Ek tu hi dhanwaan hai gori, baaqi sab kangaal

lines: Jo be-rang ho, us par kya kya rang jamaate log
couplets.en: How many colors people lay upon what has none.

lines: Jo be-rang ho, us par kya kya rang jamaate log, tu naadaan na jaane kaise roop churaate log
Nazrein bhar bhar dekhein tujh ko aate jaate log, chhail chhabeeli raani thoda
couplets.en: People color what has none, and you scarcely know how passersby steal your beauty by drinking you in with their eyes.

lines: Chhail chhabeeli raani, thoda ghoonghat aur nikaal
Ek tu hi dhanwaan hai gori, baaqi sab kangaal
couplets.en: Draw your veil a little farther, lovely one, for you alone are rich and all the rest are poor.

lines: Dhanak, ghata, kaliyaan aur taare, sab hain tere roop
Dhanak, ghata, kaliyaan aur taare, sab hain tere roop
couplets.en: Rainbow, raincloud, buds and stars are all forms of your beauty.

lines: Dhanak, ghata, kaliyaan aur taare, sab hain tere roop
Ghazlein hon ya geet hon mere, sab mein tera roop
couplets.en: I see your beauty in rainbow, raincloud, buds and stars, and in every ghazal or song I make.

lines: Yoon hi chamakti rahe hamesha tere husn ki dhoop
Tujhe nazar na lage kisi ki, tujhe nazar na lage kisi ki, jiye hazaaron saal
couplets.en: May the sunlight of your beauty shine forever, may the evil eye pass you by, and may you live a thousand years.
